title: Restocking Top-Up Schedule for Northgate Marketplace Seller Refunds
content:
Refund schedule of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee: the restocking top-up.

**Return handled.** The return handled is the return request most recently answered on the order with a return authorization (where two such entries share a date, the one recorded first counts), and the line, the returned units, the reason and the request date are the ones that request records. The refunds on the returned line are every refund entry recorded there as a return refund, top-ups already booked included; the seller's unit refunds among them are the entries that refund units, with the units they refund. The returned line's set price per unit is its line amount divided by the units bought on it, and the price paid for the returned units is that set price per unit times the returned units; the units of the returned line kept at the set price are the units bought on it less the units asked back on it by change-of-mind return requests.

**Amount.** The refund owed for the returned units is the listed unit price of their line times the returned units, and the restocking top-up is that refund owed less the refunds on the returned line; it never falls below zero, and only that final figure is rounded half up to the cent. Every amount that sets the merchandise value of the returned units or is taken from the refund owed for the returned units enters before the refunds on the line are subtracted.

**When a top-up is owed.** A top-up is owed only where the order is of a seller program other than Fulfilled by Northgate and was paid with an external card and carries no more than ten lines, the order carries a single return authorization, the returned line carries exactly one return request, the seller's unit refunds on the returned line cover every returned unit; it is then the refund owed less the refunds on the returned line, and otherwise, or wherever that comes to zero, the top-up is settled with nothing booked and the base rule stands: "The seller must refund within the program's seller refund time in business days after the return is delivered, the price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most the program's maximum restocking percentage on an opened change-of-mind return, plus the original shipping charge where the program refunds the original shipping on a seller-fault return and the reason is a seller fault and never for a change of mind."

**Hypothetical worked case.** A Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled order paid by external card has a single return authorization, for 1 unit of a line of 1 unit listed at USD 300.00; the seller's unit refund on the line refunded that unit with 240.00. The refund owed is 300.00 times 1, that is 300.00, and the top-up is 300.00 less 240.00, that is 60.00. Where the refunds on the line already reach 300.00, the figure is zero and the top-up is settled with nothing booked.
